name: Mr.Guardian_bot
description: Mr.Guardian_bot - Telegram Message Forwarding UserBot & Channel Forwarder with Duplicate Filter & Custom Captions

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID from https://my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API HASH from https://my.telegram.org

BOT_OWNER.description: Numeric Telegram User ID of the Bot Owner (from @userinfobot)

STRING_SESSION.description: Optional: Pyrogram String Session for the UserBot (starts with BQED...). Can also be added in bot settings.

CHANNEL_USERNAME.description: Your target channel username for branding (e.g. @moviesguardianss)

FORWARD_SLEEP.description: Forwarding delay per message in seconds (default: 1.8 for safe speed)
